hints.title: Triplet Allocation Strategy
hints.text: In each round of 3 piles, Alice takes the largest, you take the second largest, and Bob takes the smallest.

hints.title: Give Smallest to Bob
hints.text: Give Bob the n / 3 smallest piles overall so that you and Alice divide the remaining 2n / 3 largest piles.

hints.title: Sorted Stepping
hints.text: Sort piles ascending. Skip the first n / 3 piles (Bob), and take every second pile from index n / 3 to the end.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary triplet selections fail to maximize the candidate second largest sum.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting takes O(N log N) time, followed by an O(N) stride accumulation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies greedy pairing: sacrifice the lowest values to Bob to reserve high values for self and Alice.
complexity.notes: Piles length is always a multiple of 3.
